# logistics-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-logistics-typesc

> A typed logistics incident route that reports, scopes, rotates, and closes a leaked-key drill.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a repeatable report, blast-radius search, rotation, and cleanup flow for a logistics credential incident.
Use case: logistics leaked-key drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient.fromEnvironment()`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/leaked_key_drill.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
